title: Premier League
description: Manchester City host Brighton & Hove Albion in Matchweek 9 of the Premier League at the Etihad Stadium. Top of the table but beaten in their last league outing, City face a Brighton side that has won two of the last four meetings.

title: Not Easily Broken
description: Dave Johnson (Morris Chestnut) and his wife, Clarice (Taraji P. Henson), appear to have it all, but she has ignored his needs while she pursues a real-estate career. The couple's already weakened marriage faces the ultimate test after Clarice is involved in a car accident, leaving her with a terrible leg injury. Dave finds a sympathetic ear -- and possibly more -- with the physical therapist (Maeve Quinlan) who comes to treat her.

title: CVM News at 7
description: Stay informed with the latest breaking news and headlines.

title: Little
description: Jordan is a take-no-prisoners tech mogul who torments her long-suffering assistant, April, and the rest of her employees on a daily basis. She soon faces an unexpected threat to her personal life and career when she magically transforms into a 13-year-old version of herself right before a do-or-die presentation. Jordan will now need to rely on April more than ever -- if April is willing to stop treating Jordan like a 13-year-old child with an attitude problem.

title: The Forge
description: A year out of high school with no plans for his future, a boy is challenged by his single mom and a successful businessman to start charting a better course for his life. Through the prayers of his mother and biblical discipleship from his new mentor, he begins discovering God's purpose for his life is so much more than he could hope for or imagine.

title: I Still Believe
description: The true-life story of Christian music star Jeremy Camp and his journey of love and loss, which attempts to prove there is always hope.

title: Premier League
description: Arsenal host Hull City in Matchweek 10 of the Premier League at the Emirates Stadium. First in the table and winners of their last four league games, Arsenal welcome a Hull side sitting 11th and winless in their last four league games.
